source: Reference pages in discussion/reference-comics/ (Matt's style references). Units: cap = the balloon's own lettering cap height. Measured 2026-09-29 by segmentation (sharp) on 2-3x upscaled scans; every silhouette checked on overlay crops.

shaken.note: Scalloped/wavy contour, ~14-17 small bumps round the balloon; same fill, lettering and stroke as speech. Roughness 4-5x ordinary speech.

usage.use: Calm dialogue from a speaker in the panel
usage.look: White rounded balloon hugging the text, short straight tapered tail to the mouth
cite: Crisis 8 TIME TO SAVE THE WORLD (id 18)

usage.use: Dialogue placed against a panel border to save space; common for long lines at the top of a panel
usage.look: Same balloon with one side cut flat by the panel border; no outline on the cut side
cite: Darkseid page YOU WASTE YOUR BREATH (id 52)

usage.use: One speaker, successive beats or a pause inside one speech
usage.look: Two or three balloons joined by a short neck; only the last carries the tail
cite: X-Men 137 IF EVEN ONE / IT'S BETTER (id 2)
Avengers ALL WE ASK / OUR QUARREL / WILL YOU (crops/ref-43.png)

usage.use: Speaker outside the panel or far away
usage.look: Ordinary balloon whose tail runs long and thin to the panel edge or toward a distant figure
cite: X-Men 132 PIERCE, WYNGARDE (long tail to the left edge; crops/ref-13.png)
X-Men 137 top tier (tails toward small distant figures; id 0)

usage.use: One line continuing into the next panel
usage.look: Balloon joined by a long tail/connector across the gutter to the next balloon
White jagged burst, 6-13 irregular spikes, bigger heavier lettering (1.6-3.5x dialogue cap), usually with a tail

usage.use: Anguished scream, a name cried from a distance
usage.look: Red-filled ragged balloon, large black lettering
Balloon with a red, wavy second outline
In the references panic is drawn as angular bursts (AllTime Comics: NO!, HELP!!, ATLASSS!, AAAIIIEEEE I'M BURNING!), heavy italic lettering. Not a wobbly line.
cite: AllTime Comics 15 top tier and last panel (crops/ref-57.png, ref-58.png, ref-65.png)

usage.look: Same balloon as speech with a scalloped, wavy contour (8-17 small bumps)
cite: Avengers MY HEAD'S SPINNING, THIS MUST BE SOME SORT OF TRICK, IT'S THE ONLY POSSIBLE ANSWER (crops/ref-44.png, ref-45.png, ref-47.png)

usage.look: Ordinary balloon with a thin zigzag (lightning) tail
No cloud thought balloons appear in these references. Thought is carried by a yellow caption in quotation marks (X-Men 137) or a yellow-filled speech balloon (Amazing Spider-Man 33)
cite: Amazing Spider-Man 33 MY HEAD-- IT'S SPINNING (crops/ref-34.png, ref-35.png)

usage.look: Square-cornered box, thin black rule, yellow (#eae619 / #eeeb32), cream (#f9ddb6) or orange (#f4b819); butted into a panel corner or run as a full-width band
cite: X-Men 132 AS FOR OUR CAPTURED MUTANTS band (id 14)

usage.kind: voice from a machine, screen, radio or chat
usage.look: DOES NOT EXIST in the references: no panel shows a device, screen or robot speaking (the X-Men 137 machine is silent; the Darkseid monologue is ordinary speech). Options, each citing a real reference element: (1) ordinary speech balloon with its tail to the screen/device (cite the off-panel tail of X-Men 132 PIERCE, WYNGARDE); (2) a caption box in quotation marks (cite X-Men 132's quoted banner caption and X-Men 137's quoted thought caption); (3) text drawn on the screen inside the art (no reference shows this).

metric.name: nearest-neighbour silhouette IoU
metric.how: Take the balloon silhouette (body + tail, fill only, no outline), centre it on its bbox centre, scale uniformly so its longer side = 92 of a 96x96 grid (aspect preserved), rasterize; IoU against every reference speech silhouette (samples[].path_cap_units, same normalization); score = max IoU.
